quickAnswerTitle: Quick Answer: Hawaii School Calendar 2026-2027 Dates
quickAnswer: The 2026-2027 Hawaii public school calendar starts Monday, August 3, 2026 and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. HIDOE lists 180 student instructional days and 189 teacher work days on the statewide traditional calendar.
about:
Hawaii public school calendars are different from most state calendar systems because Hawaii operates one statewide public school system through the Hawaii State Department of Education, not a network of independent county districts. Most public school families therefore start with the HIDOE school calendar instead of searching for a separate Honolulu, Maui, Kauai, or Hawaii Island district calendar.

The statewide HIDOE calendar includes student work year dates, teacher work year dates, fall break, winter break, spring break, state holidays, teacher workdays, institute day windows, quarter endings, and last day information. Families should still verify school-specific details with their campus, because charter schools, multitrack schools, athletics, testing schedules, graduation ceremonies, complex-area notices, emergency closures, and individual school events may use separate calendars or local announcements.

stateSections.label: How Hawaii School Calendars Are Different
stateSections.content:
Unlike most states, Hawaii operates one statewide public school system through HIDOE. Families usually do not need to search by county district for the main attendance calendar because the student work year, major breaks, state holidays, and teacher work year dates are centrally managed.

That statewide structure creates a different search pattern from states such as Texas, Florida, or California. A query like "Honolulu school calendar" or "Maui school calendar" usually points back to the statewide HIDOE calendar first, then to school-level announcements for campus events, charter school dates, or multitrack schedules.

stateSections.content: The 2026-2027 HIDOE calendar uses a statewide traditional calendar as the baseline for most Hawaii public schools. The official source also identifies teacher work year dates and alternate calendar considerations that families should check before relying on a single date list.

stateSections.label: How We Verify Hawaii Calendar Dates
stateSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official HIDOE school calendar source before publishing Hawaii statewide calendar dates. For the 2026-2027 page, the reviewed source is the HIDOE official school calendar approved June 1, 2023 and amended March 30, 2026.

The review process checks the official PDF, records the source version, extracts first day, last day, fall break, winter break, spring break, state holidays, teacher workdays, institute day windows, student day counts, teacher day counts, and alternate calendar notes, then records the last verification date shown on the page.

faqs.q: When do Hawaii public schools start?
faqs.a: Hawaii public school students start the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026, according to the HIDOE official calendar.

faqs.q: Does Hawaii have one statewide public school calendar?
faqs.a: Most Hawaii public schools use the statewide Hawaii State Department of Education calendar. Families should still verify charter school, multitrack, and school-specific dates directly with their school.

faqs.q: Is Hawaii DOE the same as a school district?
faqs.a: HIDOE is not a typical local school district. Hawaii operates a statewide public school system through the Hawaii State Department of Education, so the main public school calendar is managed statewide rather than by separate county districts.

faqs.q: Does Honolulu have a separate school calendar?
faqs.a: Most Honolulu public schools use the statewide HIDOE calendar for first day, breaks, holidays, teacher workdays, and last day dates. Families should still check their individual school for testing, athletics, graduation, and campus-specific events.

faqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Spring Break?
faqs.a: Hawaii public schools Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027 for the 2026-2027 school year.

faqs.q: When does Hawaii school summer break start?
faqs.a: For most Hawaii public school students, summer break begins after the last student day on Thursday, May 27, 2027. Families should verify school-specific end-of-year events and graduation dates separately.

faqs.q: Are Hawaii schools closed on state holidays?
faqs.a: HIDOE calendars list Hawaii state holidays and other school closure dates, but families should use the official school-year calendar for exact dates and confirm campus notices for school-specific schedules.

faqs.q: Where can I download the Hawaii school calendar PDF?
faqs.a: The Hawaii State Department of Education calendar page on MySchoolDates links to available official HIDOE PDF sources and summarizes the key dates in a searchable format.

faqs.q: Do Hawaii charter schools follow the HIDOE calendar?
faqs.a: Not always. Hawaii charter schools may publish separate calendars, so families should confirm attendance dates directly with the charter school.

faqs.q: What is the Holomua multitrack calendar?
faqs.a: HIDOE publishes a separate Holomua Elementary multitrack calendar for schools that do not follow every date on the standard statewide traditional calendar. Families at those schools should verify the multitrack PDF and campus notices.

faqs.q: Can I add the Hawaii school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. The Hawaii State Department of Education calendar page on MySchoolDates includes calendar download options when available, including ICS files that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
